mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening supply-side environment that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the yield curve inverts (DGS10 < DGS2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% YoY decline, signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines by > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, defined as PAYEMS rising by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 100 bps increase over 6 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by > 1% in 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate loans, defined as a 5% YoY decline in RSAFS, signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS declines by > 5% YoY.
